data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2019 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were 1,532.1m. Using the gross claims development triangle, prior-year development for years up to 2017 produced a net favourable movement of 18.5m (a release, approximately 1.2% of opening gross claims). The report attributes improved claims experience principally to better attritional loss experience (notably Cargo, Property lineslips and Marine Hull following remediation work in 2018) and a reduction in large losses, partially offset by adverse development in some Property exposures.
raw_causal_phrases: There has been a reassessment of the net provision for claims outstanding held at the previous year end. The release in 2019 amounted to $41.5m (2018: $42.8m), attributable to the following classes of business:

The improvement in the net claims ratio of 13.4% was primarily due to better attritional loss experience across a number of classes most notable Cargo, Property Lineslips, and Marine Hull, following remediation work undertaken in 2018.
Large losses decreased by $5.6m, with the largest claims in the current year being the disturbances in Hong Kong and Chile, a shipyard crane collapse and the explosion at a refinery plant.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross opening reserve taken from balance sheet (claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2018 = 1,532.1). The 'Movement in prior year's provision' note in the accounts states a net release of $41.5m but is explicitly a net (after reinsurance) figure; a gross prior-year movement was not provided in that note. The gross prior-year development (-18.5m) was computed from the published gross claims development triangle (page 35) by comparing the current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years <=2017 (triangle is gross). LOB-level movements in the movement note are net amounts; gross splits by LOB were not provided, so per-LOB gross amounts are null. Some class name to standard LOB mapping is ambiguous (e.g. 'Speciality'); where mapping was unclear the LOB movement entry uses the original class name. All amounts are in the report currency (USD), not converted.
